prompt_head:
Job: Forward Deployed Engineer (Fort Lauderdale/Miami) at TribalScale
<requirements>
- (required) Professional experience building and deploying production-grad

paragraphs.text: I'm applying for the Forward Deployed Engineer role in Fort Lauderdale/Miami. The posting asks for agent loops with tool selection and human approval steps, and I have built that end to end. I built Job Fit Agent, a LangGraph agent that scores job postings against an evidence base and drafts documents only after a human approves them. I also built the eval gates and prompt injection defenses around it, so bad outputs get caught before they ship.

The harder part is making agents safe to run without someone watching them. My tycodes.app demo generator turns a business URL into a shoppable 3D demo in about 1 min, through a six-stage agent pipeline on Cloudflare Workers. It includes automated verification of pricing and claims. Job Fit Agent ships with Langfuse tracing, a daily cost cap, and GitHub Actions CI that covers linting, strict typing, 70 tests, and the eval gate. On the client side, I designed integration blueprints and live demo environments to onboard high-value enterprise clients, and I built a custom ingestion pipeline that cut service delivery times by over 30%.

The gap is cloud platforms. I have not shipped on AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud. My production work runs on Cloudflare Workers, Postgres, and Docker. The posting asks for one of those three clouds, and nothing on my record covers it yet. My plan is to take one of my pipelines and rebuild its runtime and storage on the cloud your team uses, then write up what changed so your engineers can check the work.
I'd like to talk about how your team runs agents in front of clients and where I would fit. I'm free for a call whenever works for you.
